gen-gf-offside-gf-play: Play reads clean and compact, with barely any shift between its capitals and lowercase. Offside earns its place up top, big and brief, where its widely spaced, open-ended curves can stretch out.
gen-gf-offside-gf-port-lligat-sans: Expressive and wide-set, Offside holds a flat, level line from stem to curve. Port Lligat Sans does the quieter work below, packing its letters tightly with bowls left open on one side.
gen-gf-offside-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra comes in with a prominent x-height and a tidy sans finish, easy on the eye. Offside sits above it, wide and flat in line weight.
gen-gf-offside-gf-rambla: Commanding Offside spreads its letters wide, with curves that never quite close and a level line. And Rambla follows with small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, so a long page feels tidy and plain.
gen-gf-offside-gf-recursive: Wide, open-ended and unshaded, this heading looks like it was cut with a ruler. Offside is happiest being large and declarative, while Recursive keeps its sans lines tall and the same in every direction.
gen-gf-offside-gf-roboto-condensed: Curves that refuse to close give Offside its look. It makes a loud, wide-tracked statement up top, while Roboto Condensed runs a plain sans line below, tightly knit and enlarged.
gen-gf-offside-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified without growing in size. Its steady weight from word to word gives Offside's wide, expressive curves something quiet to stand against.
gen-gf-offside-gf-secular-one: Wide, open curves and a level, unaccented line. Secular One then settles in with a dominant midsection and zero modulation, so a longer passage reads dense, sturdy and unvarying.
gen-gf-offside-gf-smooch-sans: Expressive Offside stretches wide with curves that never close, and nothing in the line shifts in weight. Smooch Sans is the tight counterpart, a plain sans with a high midline and gaps that nearly vanish.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Open-ended curves and wide tracking give Offside a bold, unshaded presence that carries the top of the page. Sofia Sans Condensed works below it with a big x-height and no calligraphic shading.
